name: deltao_hsi
info: Outlier distance (delta_o) in the HSi part. Only indices 2 and 3 (CE-H low/high density) are actually read by this producer; indices 0 and 1 are inert here but set to the same value for simplicity. Default value is 2.6 (same range as deltac/deltas, since this parameter did not exist independently before the split; no separate historical range to reuse).
